info.description: Generated by `php artisan api:openapi` from the route table and docs/PERMISSION_MATRIX.md. Browser pages are Inertia responses (HTML on first load, JSON with `X-Inertia: true`). See docs/API.md.

session.name: infernix_one_session
session.description: Laravel session cookie after login + MFA. State-changing requests also need the X-XSRF-TOKEN header (CSRF).
